intro: We hold a recorded main-programme fee of up to ₹{{budget}} lakh for {{count}} published BCA colleges in India. This list of the best BCA colleges under ₹{{budget}} lakh is a fee filter, not a national ranking of teaching quality.

MS Ramaiah College of Arts, Science and Commerce and Mount Carmel College, both in Bangalore, lead the first cards, with recorded BCA fees of ₹85,000 and ₹95,666. Later cards show much lower figures that may be annual tuition.
Most colleges here are private. Uttar Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, Maharashtra and Punjab have the most listings.
listLead: These are the top BCA colleges in India 2026 with a recorded main-programme fee of up to ₹1 lakh. A few colleges have a fee range that crosses ₹1 lakh, so read the minimum and maximum on the card.
snapshot: Across {{feeN}} published colleges with a recorded fee, the median total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
{{private}} colleges are private, {{public}} are public, and {{count}} is the list size. A handful of records have no ownership type.
GGSIPU CET is the only entrance test with a recorded count on this list. Many BCA admissions are college-level or through a state or university process that is not tagged here.
firstCollegesLead: Prestige Institute of Management and Research, Indore, and St Xavier's College, Ahmedabad, have recorded BCA fees close to ₹33,000. St Xavier's has no ownership type in our records.
St Joseph's College, Devagiri, is listed at ₹11,333, and a few Uttar Pradesh and Tamil Nadu colleges are close to ₹12,000. Figures that low are often annual, so confirm the official full-course fee.

sections.heading: How to read a BCA fee under ₹1 lakh
paragraphs: Our filter uses the main recorded BCA fee. If a college also offers a higher-fee specialised BCA, that programme may not be the one on the card.
Aliah University, Kolkata, is one of the public colleges near the top, with a recorded fee range of ₹12,900–₹14,100. Check the official notice for the latest year.

compare.heading: How to compare the best BCA colleges under ₹1 lakh
paragraphs: A Bangalore private college and a public university BCA can both fit this budget and still differ in labs, internships and entrance rules.
bullets: Whether the fee is for one year or the full three-year BCA, and what exam or laboratory charges add.
The admission route, including CUET, a university CET, or direct college admission.
The official programme name, so you are not comparing a general BCA with a specialised or honours variant.
The city and living costs, which are not included in the tuition figures here.

faqs.question: How many BCA colleges in India have fees under ₹1 lakh here?
faqs.answer: We list {{published}} published BCA colleges with a recorded main-programme fee up to ₹{{budget}} lakh. Colleges without a usable fee on file are not in this budget list.

faqs.question: What is a typical BCA fee on this list?
faqs.answer: Among the {{feeN}} colleges, the median recorded total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half falls between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}. Confirm whether the official notice is annual or for the full course.

faqs.question: Why do some BCA fees look as low as ₹12,000?
faqs.answer: A few early cards show figures just above ₹10,000. We do not treat fees under ₹10,000 as valid minimums. Confirm the official full-course fee before you treat a low figure as the complete cost.

faqs.question: Are government BCA colleges included?
faqs.answer: Yes. {{public}} public colleges are on this list, alongside {{private}} private colleges. Public does not automatically mean a lower official fee in every city.

faqs.question: Is this a ranking of the best BCA colleges in India?
faqs.answer: No. It is a fee filter for the best BCA colleges under ₹1 lakh in our records. Use the college site and, where relevant, the BCA colleges in India listing to compare academics.
